summaryEn: Teaches you to say your name, where you are from and where you live.
Teaches you to ask how someone is, say how you are and put the question back.
Teaches you who to address informally, who formally, and how the verb changes.
Teaches you to use question words to ask where someone is from, where they live and what something is.
Teaches you to ask about languages with the verb first and say which ones you speak.
Teaches you to count to a hundred, give your phone number and ask a price.
Teaches you to spell your name and ask how a word is written.
Teaches you to say your profession, what you do and which company you work for.
Teaches you to give your age, ask someone else's and say where you were born.
Teaches you to understand and answer the name, address and postcode questions on an official form.
Teaches you to introduce family members and how the possessive changes with the noun.
Teaches you to talk about your siblings and how a masculine noun changes as an object.
Teaches you to say that something is not there, with the ready-made refusals of daily life.
Teaches you to introduce your pet and say its name and how old it is.
Teaches you to ask about people in a photo and use 'our' and 'her' possessives.
Teaches you why German plurals have to be learnt and how they work with numbers and quantities.
Teaches you to describe someone's appearance and that traits and body parts take different verbs.
Teaches you how the verb ending changes when you talk about someone else.
Teaches you to negate verbs and adjectives, and where the negation goes in the sentence.
Teaches you to plan a family gathering: who is coming and who is bringing what.
Teaches you to order politely and ask for the bill.
Teaches you to say what you eat and drink for breakfast.
Teaches you to order quickly at a snack bar, ask the price and ask for it to take away.
Teaches you to order politely in a restaurant and pay the bill.
Teaches you to say what you enjoy eating and what you prefer.
Teaches you to say what you need and ask for what you are looking for.
Teaches you to say how much you want: kilos, bottles and pieces.
Teaches you to say who is doing what in the kitchen.
Teaches you to say politely what you do not eat and what you are allergic to.
Teaches you to accept an offer at the table, decline politely and praise the food.
Teaches you to describe how a day goes: it begins, you work, you sleep.
Teaches you to ask and tell the time, and shows how German builds the half hour.
Teaches you verbs whose prefix moves to the end: aufstehen, einkaufen, anrufen.
Teaches you the days of the week and the prepositions that separate day from time.
Teaches you that the verb keeps its place when a time expression opens the sentence.
Teaches you to describe your morning in sequence: first, then, after that.
Teaches you to say when work starts and finishes and to talk about breaks.
Teaches you to say what you do after work and what you prefer.
Teaches you to describe weekend plans and to talk about plans that are not fixed.
Teaches you to ask whether someone has time and to say no politely.
Teaches you to say what you are looking for, state your choice and ask where the till is.
Teaches you to ask about size, ask to try something on and say whether it fits.
Teaches you to name colours and ask for the same item in another colour.
Teaches you to ask the price, say that something is expensive or good value, and understand a discount.
Teaches you to say that you like something, choose between two and ask the other person's opinion.
Teaches you to exchange something, give the reason and answer the question about the receipt.
Teaches you to say who a present is for, make a suggestion and ask for gift wrapping.
Teaches you to ask the price of several things, adjust the quantity and understand the total.
Teaches you to name toiletries, say what you need and ask which aisle they are in.
Teaches you to order online, add an item to the basket and talk about delivery times.
